name: Varok Saurfang
summary: In Orgrimmar, Varok Saurfang commands the Horde's war forces under Warchief Thrall. The veteran of the Old Horde's wars lends the young Horde his strength and experience.

sections.title: A Living Legend of the Wars
sections.body: Varok Saurfang carries the Old Horde's wars into the present. Few living warriors match his record, and many regard him as unstoppable in battle. Now High Overlord in Orgrimmar, he helps hold together Thrall's newborn Horde.

sections.title: The Weight of the Blood
sections.body: Varok Saurfang defends the Horde and enforces Thrall's rule against threats. He does not seek battle for its own sake. He despises warmongering and fights for honor and the Horde's preservation.

faq.answer: Varok Saurfang is a renowned orc warrior and the primary military commander serving Warchief Thrall in the Horde.

faq.q: What wars did Saurfang fight in?
aliases: did saurfang fight in the first war
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang fought in the Old Horde's wars against the Alliance. Now he fights for Thrall's Horde.

faq.q: How does Saurfang view the Horde's past?
aliases: why does saurfang regret the past
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang fought for the Old Horde in the days of the demon blood curse. Now he serves Thrall's Horde, which has turned from that path.

faq.q: What is Saurfang's role in the current Horde?
faq.answer: Varok Saurfang leads Thrall's forces as High Overlord. He oversees military readiness, enforces the Warchief's commands, and mentors younger Horde warriors.

angles.text: As an orc, you can look to High Overlord Saurfang as a paragon of martial strength and a reminder of the spiritual toll of the demonic blood curse.
As a warrior, you can revere Saurfang as a peerless veteran. His axe technique, tactical brilliance, and enduring resolve embody the ideal soldier.
